semantic_fixtures.covers: Exact actual identity, hybrid Phyrexian cost, four loyalty, Compleated, one-based Oracle presentation and all three complete typed loyalty clauses.
Actual green, white and two-life casts enter with four/four/two loyalty; Doubling Season gives eight or ordered Compleated four/six; wrong actor rejects and mana value remains four.
Actual +1 publicly reveals Creature/Planeswalker into hand without choice, adds loyalty and does not draw or lose on an empty library.

Actual unmatched +1 publishes one exact public reveal and private keep/bottom choice, preserves identity/order for keep, moves exact bottom card, and rejects wrong actors and stale repeats atomically.
Actual -3 pays source into graveyard, announces zero/three/two-one/one-one-one allocations to creatures of different controllers, places exact counters, and grants vigilance through end of turn only.

Malformed quantities, identities, generations, target domains, duplicate targets and actors reject before loyalty payment; stale recipients receive no counters/vigilance and surviving shares are not redistributed.

Actual -6 source leaves paying loyalty, persistent captured emblem matches own Creature/Planeswalker but not Artifact/opponent casts, rejects self targets, uses public Player receipts without fake battlefield source, respects Vorinclex and ten-poison loss.
Two actual Ajani emblems order independently for one creature cast and resolve against two different chosen opponents without duplicate targeting or disappearing markers.
Unchanged actual Ajani RON reveals a synthetic dual-type subject once and grants vigilance to a legal synthetic counter-prohibited creature independently of successfully placed counters.
